subject: expression: add `expression.BuildContext` to build expressions (#50662)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (vs first parent) and minimal related callers in `pkg/expression`, `pkg/planner/core`, and `pkg/table`. The change primarily introduces `expression.BuildContext` and mechanically retargets expression-building APIs (builtins/function classes, constant folding, expression rewriter entrypoints, generated-column/default-expression building) from `sessionctx.Context` to `BuildContext`, with no remaining plausible Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, concurrency, or session/transaction-behavior issues identified.
